traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Expansion meets power. Large-scale ambition, intense conviction, and a drive to overhaul inherited beliefs. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of growth and power is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Big, transformative ambition; the intensity can overshoot.
shadow: Excess and overreach fused with control and obsession, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.
base: More influence can make an ambitious plan easier to pursue and harder to question at the same time.

readerCopy.body: More influence can make an ambitious plan easier to pursue and harder to question at the same time. When Jupiter conjoins Pluto, expansion and power reinforce each other, giving money, authority, access, or a larger audience more force than usual. Success can widen what is possible without making every instinct behind it wise. The useful measure is what the added power actually changes once getting more of it stops being the goal.
